title: Simply Savage v0.5
author: Tony P.
desc:
SIMPLY SAVAGE

This is the first program I've written and published, the product of years of training, research, and more than a few mistakes. Whether you run it or not, thanks for taking a look.

Who it's for: lifters with 1+ years of experience, natural lifters, anyone bulking or maintaining, and people who want a program that's easy to follow and repeat. If you're brand new to lifting, run a basic beginner routine first and come back once the main movement patterns feel natural.


The principles:

Longevity — joint-friendly exercise selection plus the functional work most programs skip. The goal is to still be training in twenty years.
Simplicity — nothing you haven't seen before, one progression rule per week.
Coverage — everything gets trained, including what programs forget: traps, lower back, rotation, carries.
Variation — no repeats day to day, a mix of rep ranges and intensity. Every movement earned its spot on effectiveness and safety.
Modularity — each workout has three groups. Short on time or energy? Finish the main group and get out.


Structure: Main lifts are what we progress week to week, priority one. Secondary adds volume where it's needed. Functional hits the neglected stuff. Each day ends with optional work, extra credit if you've got the gas, a guilt-free skip if not. Every lift also has a listed alternate for packed gym days, same muscle, different equipment.

Progression: 5-week cycles, one job per week. Week 1, set your baseline. Week 2, add a set to main lifts. Week 3, add reps (~2). Week 4, add weight, sets and reps reset. Week 5, deload, drop a set from everything, cut the weight to roughly 60-70%, and keep every set easy. It should feel almost insulting. That's the point. Each new cycle starts a little heavier than the last, and the added sets never carry over, every cycle resets to baseline counts, just heavier.

RPE: how many reps you had left in the tank. RPE 8 means two left. Be honest, sandbagging your effort makes the program do nothing.

The top set: same weight and reps every set, but effort climbs. First set around RPE 7, last set around 9. That last set is what drives progress. If set one already feels like a 9, the weight's too heavy. If the last set feels like a 7, it's too light. Fix it at the start of the next cycle, not mid-week.

Schedule: five days, three power days (Push, Pull, Legs) and two hypertrophy days (Upper, Lower). The difference is rep ranges, intensity, and tempo.

It's not perfect, no program is. But run it as written, stay honest with your effort, and eat enough, and you'll get bigger and stronger. Now go run it.


Updates:

- Lot of changes, please refer to previous iterations for changes

v0.3 —> v0.4

- Complete overhaul of the program, please refer to previous iterations for changes

v0.4 —> v0.5

- Complete overhaul of the program and likely last. Future changes will likely be tweaks. Please refer to previous iterations for changes.

ex.note: Main lift. 2.5min rest. 2 warmup sets. Just for today, notes will be a guide. Every exercise will tell if it's main/secondary/functional/optional lift, form cues, rest, warmup, and maybe motivation.
Main lift. 60sec rest. Certain exercises have "ramping" RPE progression to your top set. Most exercises have an alternative available. Some exercises have special techniques as well labeled ST - .
Secondary lift. 90sec rest. Do weighted. For instance on this exercise, we will do a step set on the last set. So RPE 8 on set 1-2, then last set do weighted till fail, lose the weight then fail.
Main lift. 2min rest. 1 warmup set. The way RPE works is basically reps in reserve. An RPE 8 would mean you can do 2 more reps where a 10 means you tried 1 more but failed. We keep it high.

ss.note: Secondary lift. SS with reverse fly. Ultimately this is pretty easy to follow, if you ever need guidance you can come back to day 1 but should not be the case.
Functional lift. No rest after chest fly, then 90sec rest each round. This exercise shows where functional work comes into play. Exercises geared towards health rather results.

ex.note: Functional lift. 60sec rest. You can end the day after this or if you find yourself having some more energy/time, continue with additional work. I suggest doing exercises for lagging muscle groups.
Priority Optional lift. 60sec rest. After today the notes will just be form cues and occasional motivation. Rest, warmups, special techniques, and progression will be noted.
Optional lift. 60sec rest. 1 rep is each letter. Weeks will vary so you can progress, adding sets, reps, or weight. You just have to follow the instructions as to what to do.
Optional lift. 60sec rest. Just to recap, main/secondary/functional/optional lifts, ramping RPE, alternatives, special techniques. Weekly progress changes. Anything you need to know will be in note.
Main lift. 2min rest. 2 warmup sets. ST - Drop set on last set, do 6 @ RPE 9, drop weight 33% do 6, drop weight 50% do 6. Wide overhand grip. Pull bar to upper chest by driving elbows down and back.
Main lift. 2min rest. Hand and knee on bench. Hinge at hips, neutral spine. Pull DB to hip with elbow tight to side. Squeeze lat at top. Lower with control, full stretch at bottom.
Main lift. 90sec rest. Bench at 45-60°. Arms hang behind body for long-head stretch. Neutral grip throughout. Curl with no shoulder swing. Pause at peak. Slow eccentric to full stretch at bottom.
Secondary lift. 60sec rest. ST - Hold for 10sec at the bottom of last rep each set. Slight forward lean. Arms straight throughout. Drive bar down by squeezing lats. Pause and squeeze. Slow return.
Secondary lift. 60sec rest. I put band but this is machine. ST - 2-3sec hold at top of each rep. Stand tall. Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears. Slow controlled descent. Don't roll shoulders!!
Functional lift. 90sec rest. Hold plate to chest. Hinge from hips, neutral spine. Lower until hamstrings stretch, no spinal flexion. Squeeze glutes to extend. Stop at parallel don't hyperextend.
Functional lift. 60sec rest. Decline bench, hands at temples or holding plate on chest. Crunch by pulling ribs to pelvis. Slow eccentric don't free-fall. Full ROM, spine flexes.
Optional life. 90sec rest. 1 rep = 1 yard. Can do via video or instructions. Hands forward, lean into sled. Drive legs back via glute and ham extension. Stay low, maintain forward lean throughout.
Optional lift. 60sec rest. Lie chest-down on incline bench (45°). Curl by elbow flexion only, upper arm stays vertical. Pause and squeeze at peak. Slow eccentric to full stretch.
Secondary lift. 60sec rest. Pad above heels, thighs locked. Curl heels under by squeezing hamstrings. Pause at peak contraction. Slow eccentric. Hips stay pressed into pad, no lifting.
Main lift. 2.5min rest. 2 warmup sets. ST - 2sec pause on each rep at bottom. Bar on upper traps, elbows under. Knees track over toes. Descend below parallel. Drive through whole foot. Upright torso.
Main lift. 2min rest. DBs at sides. Step forward, lower back knee toward floor. Front knee tracks over toes, doesn't cave. Drive through front heel to step into next rep. Maintain upright torso.
Secondary lift. 60sec rest. Do these single leg. ST - 10sec hold at end of each set. One leg, knee pivot aligned with axis. Extend to full lockout, squeeze quad. Slow eccentric. Opposite leg relaxed.

Secondary lift. 90sec rest. DB in opposite hand from standing leg. Hinge at hip, back leg drives back as torso lowers. Maintain neutral spine. Stop when hamstring stretch ends ROM. Drive through heel.
Secondary lift. 60sec rest. Ball of foot on platform, heels hang free. Drop heels for full stretch. Drive up to full plantar flexion, pause and squeeze. Slow controlled descent to stretch. Full ROM.
Functional lift. 60sec rest. Kneel facing cable, rope at face. Hands at temples. Crunch by flexing spine, drive ribs to pelvis. Hips don't move. Pause at bottom contraction. Slow controlled return.

Optional lift. 60sec rest. ST - 3sec eccentric. Box height where working hip drops below knee. Light DBs. Step up by driving through working heel only. Top: full hip extension. Control entire descent.
Optional lift. 90sec rest. ST - Full reset between reps. Stand 12" from box. Quick countermovement, explosive triple extension. Land soft on box, hips above knees on top. Step down (don't jump down).
Main lift. 2min rest. 1 warmup set. Lean forward 20-30° for chest emphasis. Lower until shoulders below elbows. Don't shrug. Drive up through palms. Don't lock out hard at top.
Main lift. 2.5min rest per round. ST - rest pause, 2 rounds, do 1 set of 8, then 15sec rest AMRAP same weight, 15sec rest, AMRAP same weight. Neutral grip, chest tall, slight lean back forward.

Main lift. 60sec rest. Cable at low pulley, opposite side of working arm. Slight lean away. Raise arm out and slightly forward to shoulder height. Pause, slow descent. Constant tension throughout ROM.
Secondary lift. 75sec rest. Cable at lowest setting. Stand facing away, arm behind body for stretch. Curl by elbow flexion only, shoulder stays back. Pause at peak. Slow eccentric to full stretch.
Secondary lift. 75sec rest. Face away from cable, rope behind head. Elbows high and pinned. Extend at elbow only, upper arms stay still. Full lockout overhead with tricep squeeze. Slow stretch back.
Functional lift. 60sec rest. Barbell in landmine, hold end with both hands at chest height. Pivot at hips, rotate bar from side to side. Brace core throughout. Knees soft, hips drive rotation.

Functional lift. 90sec rest. Heavy DB/KB in one hand. Stand tall, ribs down, core braced. Walk normally without leaning toward the weight. Stay tall through hips and shoulders. Switch hands each trip.
Optional lift. 90sec rest. Single arm. Stand tall, palm forward or neutral. Brace core hard. Press straight overhead, full lockout. Lower with control. Don't lean, core resists rotation.
Optional lift. 60sec rest. Lie chest down on incline bench. DBs hang straight down. Row with elbows flared 60-90°. Pull to upper ribs/mid-back. Squeeze rhomboids and rear delts at top. Slow stretch.

Secondary lift. 60sec rest. 1 warmup set. Pad above heels, thighs locked. Curl heels toward glutes by squeezing hamstrings. Pause at peak contraction. Slow eccentric. Hips stay pressed into pad.
Main lift. 2min rest. Upper back on bench, bar across hips (use pad). Feet shoulder-width, drive through heels. Extend hips fully, squeeze glutes hard at top. Chin tucked, ribs down. Slow eccentric.
Main lift. 2.5min rest. ST - deficit, 2sec pause at bottom of each rep. Rear foot on bench, long front stride. Lean torso forward. Lower hip back, knee tracks over toes. Drive through front heel.
Secondary lift. 2min rest. DBs at thighs, soft knee bend. Hinge at hips, DBs slide down legs. Neutral spine throughout. Lower until hamstring stretch ends ROM. Drive hips forward, squeeze glutes.
Secondary lift. 90sec rest. Face away from low cable, rope between legs. Hinge at hips, let rope pull hands back through legs. Drive hips forward, squeeze glutes at lockout. Neutral spine.

Functional lift. 60sec rest each round. Heels on platform, toes hang off. Lift toes up toward shins as high as possible. Pause at peak contraction. Slow eccentric. Don't compensate with knee or hip.
